app.name: FAIRCASE
app.description: Advanced legal research and case analysis platform powered by artificial intelligence

hero.title: Legal Research,
hero.subtitle: Harness AI to analyze case law, track precedents, and generate compliance reports with unmatched accuracy across Canadian jurisdictions.

features.title: Enterprise Legal Intelligence
features.subtitle: Everything your legal team needs to stay ahead
features.caseAnalysisDesc: AI-powered case law analysis with precedent identification and risk scoring across common and civil law jurisdictions.
features.complianceReportsDesc: Automated compliance reporting with configurable templates, audit trails, and regulatory mapping for multi-jurisdictional operations.
features.precedentTrackingDesc: Real-time precedent monitoring with citation network analysis and impact assessment for evolving legal landscapes.
features.riskAssessmentDesc: Quantitative legal risk scoring using historical outcomes, jurisdiction-specific factors, and predictive analytics.
features.auditTrailsDesc: Tamper-evident audit logging with hash-chain integrity verification and complete evidence lifecycle management.
features.teamCollaborationDesc: Role-based access control, dual-control workflows, and secure document sharing for distributed legal teams.

mission.title: Defending Justice with Intelligence
mission.description: FAIRCASE empowers legal professionals with AI-driven tools that reduce research time by 80%, surface critical precedents in seconds, and ensure compliance across every jurisdiction where you operate.
mission.highlight: Built in Canada for the world's most demanding legal environments.

cta.title: Ready to Transform Your Legal Practice?
cta.subtitle: Join hundreds of firms using FAIRCASE to deliver better outcomes faster.

footer.description: AI-powered legal intelligence for modern legal teams.

publicIntake.pageSubtitle: Share a bit about your situation so a qualified reviewer can look at it. This is not legal advice. It is a way to get supervised help started.
